Title: Generally available: Azure Communication Services mobile UI library

Body.Content:
Save time and reduce complexity for utilizing Azure Communication Services mobile UI library which provides production ready UI components for mobile apps. 

This release includes support for 13 languages, accessibility for UI components, and the ability to view shared screen content—including pinch-to-zoom, which is a key feature for mobile users.

Read the blog and learn more.
